changes: First Modwerk release of Zac-Kyoti's QUANTIZE LIVE REC gesture, listed as Quant Live Rec: hold [REC] and tap [PLAY] to see the PERSONALIZE setting in a toast, LIVE REC: QUANTIZED or LIVE REC: UNQUANTIZED; tap [PLAY] again while it is up to switch it. The first [REC] + [PLAY] still starts live recording as on stock.

Modwerk changes to the author's source: reworded toasts, a redraw so an open PERSONALIZE list follows a flip, and the flip's two stores and redraw call re-encoded so its USB package repeats no stock code; the same calls in the same order.

Over USB for beta testers: loaded, kept, undone and removed on the Modwerk beta base on an MKII, with the gesture, the PERSONALIZE redraw and a power cycle checked there. Card builds were tested on an MKII from an earlier build of the same behaviour. Not tested: an MKI with this build, Part or project reload with it installed, grid recording, MIDI tracks; the frame-interrupt benchmark and stress run were not measured (key-handler code only).
